mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password_hash, status, role ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{role}, 'USER') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, status, role, phone_number, phone_verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, email, password_hash, status, role, phone_number, phone_verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, email, password_hash, status, role, phone_number, phone_verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = #{role}
SELECT id, email, status, role, phone_verified_at, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
